## Repeat

In a clean
checkout of this directory, with Node.js/npm available and the configured isolated account credentials in the environment:\n\n```b

ash
cd /workspace/mcpjam-validation
./run-eval.sh
```

The script installs pinned dependencies if absent, validates the suite
, uploads/updates the same declared suite ID in `project_fixture`, starts a fresh run, waits for the verdict, and writes reports.
It preserves MCPJam'\"'s verdict exit code. A fresh invocation starts a fresh run; use the CLI's printed idempotency key only to r

ecover a lost launch response. Credentials are read from the environment, never saved here.

ects a wrong expected sum.\n3. The documented per-step evidence route is unimplemented here (`steps.json`). Used the iteration end

point'"'s actual tool call/result and the completed decision report instead.
